summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K notifying the postponement of an Extraordinary General Meeting to June 8, 2026, originally called for May 28. The agenda includes reformulation of bylaws reflecting a new Shareholders' Agreement (referenced in Material Facts of April 20 and 23, 2026) and governance changes, election of Board members, and shortening the Executive Board term to two years starting from April 29, 2026, AGM election. This filing is a routine EGM postponement and convocation, not a special-situation event. The board chairperson, Magda Chambriard, oversees the process. The meeting is digital per CVM Resolution 81.
